how: NYC Parks lists marked hiking trails (Staten Island Greenbelt, Van Cortlandt, Pelham Bay) and runs guided hikes with Urban Park Rangers.
Row New York offers free beginner rowing lessons at Paerdegat Basin, and Sebago Canoe Club hosts community open houses with rowing outings on Jamaica Bay.
venue: Row New York / Paerdegat Basin Community Dock

how: Ring-making and silversmithing classes run at Ayaka Nishi Jewelry Design School and other studios listed on CourseHorse; tools and materials are supplied.
Central Park's Ramble and Jamaica Bay Wildlife Refuge are major birding sites, with NYC Bird Alliance guiding birders to sites across the five boroughs.
venue: Central Park Ramble / Jamaica Bay Wildlife Refuge

how: Riverdale Yacht Club (Bronx) has taught sailing on Optimist, Laser and 420 dinghies; Hudson River Community Sailing and Atlantic Yachting teach small-boat and keelboat sailing on the Hudson.
Offshore Sailing School runs lessons from North Cove Marina in Battery Park, and Hudson River Community Sailing offers beginner classes from its boathouse.
Geocaching.com lists active caches in NYC parks such as Cunningham Park.
Cunningham Park in Queens has about 6.5 miles of graded mountain-bike trails built and maintained by the CLIMB volunteer group.
PADI Open Water courses with a Manhattan pool run at Scuba Network and Scuba.com New York, and Captain Mike's Diving Services on City Island is a 5-star PADI facility.
Aalokam NY teaches Bharatanatyam to adults and children in Manhattan and Brooklyn with a free trial class; Dakshina Palli also teaches in Midtown.
Scratch DJ Academy (Cooper Square), Dubspot and Garnish Music Production School teach DJing and turntablism in small classes.
Garnish Music Production School and Dubspot run Ableton Live, Logic Pro and mixing courses with 4-student classes.
Brooklyn Craft Company runs a beginner Bookbinding 101 class (long-stitch journal) and Manifesto in Gowanus offers bookbinding workshops.
Leatherworking workshops to make wallets and cases run at Brooklyn studios listed on CourseHorse, including Manifesto in Gowanus.
NY Tango School holds weekly beginner group classes and a milonga practice; no partner or experience required.
The Chinese Music Ensemble of New York (founded 1961) is a Chinese orchestra with concerts and lessons; Columbia Chinese Orchestra is a student group.
venue: Chinese Music Ensemble of New York

how: The Chinese Music Ensemble of New York lists private lessons including erhu.
venue: Chinese Music Ensemble of New York

how: China Institute in Lower Manhattan launched guqin, erhu and guzheng classes; private teachers also advertise in NYC.
Gamelan Kusuma Laras (Javanese) and Gamelan Dharma Swara (Balinese) are community ensembles based at the Indonesian Consulate in Manhattan.
Troupes such as New York United Lion and Dragon Dance Troupe practise in Sara D. Roosevelt Park, and W.O.W. Project and NY Choy Lay Fut run lion dance teams in Chinatown.
Catch-and-release fishing is allowed at Central Park's Harlem Meer (NY State licence needed for ages 16+), with Central Park Conservancy fishing programs and bamboo-pole loans when running.
Harlem Meer in Central Park holds largemouth bass, sunfish, carp and chain pickerel and is open to catch-and-release angling.
Board game cafes such as Hex & Co. (500+ games, walk-in cover charge), The Uncommons and The Brooklyn Strategist let visitors play from large libraries.
Waypoint on the Lower East Side is a gaming cafe with 30 PCs for titles such as League of Legends and Fortnite.
CurlNYC and Brooklyn Lakeside Curling Club run learn-to-curl sessions and leagues on Prospect Park's ice; Long Island Curling Club curls at Syosset.
Dozens of independent record stores including Academy Records, Rough Trade NYC, Generation Records and Brooklyn Record Exchange sell new and used vinyl.

activity: Hands-on cooking classes (pasta and other cuisines)
how: CocuSocial, Red Inside Culinary and Murray's Cheese run hands-on fresh pasta classes in Manhattan.

activity: Artisan bread and pastry baking courses
how: NY Cake Academy offers a Bread Making Certificate Series and focaccia classes.
NYC has fenced dog runs (Tompkins Square, Chelsea Waterside, Carl Schurz Park) and park areas that allow off-leash dogs before 9am and after 9pm.
Ballet Hispanico School of Dance offers adult flamenco classes open to all levels, and Flamenco Vivo Carlota Santana runs classes at its Center for Flamenco Arts.

No free-roaming wildlife safari exists in the metro area; the nearest drive-through safari is Six Flags Great Adventure in Jackson, New Jersey, about 1.5 hours away, and the Bronx Zoo only has enclosed exhibits.

There are no natural geothermal springs in the New York metro area; the nearest are in Berkeley Springs, West Virginia, roughly 5 hours away (Korean spas such as Spa Castle in Queens use heated pools instead).
Firearm discharge and hunting are banned in the five boroughs; the nearest deer hunting is on Long Island's east end and in the Hudson Valley, roughly 1.5-2 hours away.
The metro area has no launch ridges; the nearest hang gliding is at Ellenville in the Shawangunks, about 2 hours away, or Kitty Hawk Kites' tow operation in New Jersey.
Manhattan Kayak Company runs SUP yoga classes and A-Team Paddleboarding in Rockaway Park offers yoga on paddleboards.
Highland Park Disc Golf Course, a 10-hole permanent course opened in 2024 on the Brooklyn/Queens border, was built by the NYC Disc Golf Association with NYC Parks.
Everybody Sing New York is a free no-audition weekly community choir on the Upper West Side, and Washington Heights Community Choir is a no-audition adult chorus.
The Metropolitan Museum of Art, MoMA, the Guggenheim and many others are open daily to visitors.
MoMA and the Guggenheim show modern and contemporary art, and Chelsea has a dense cluster of free commercial galleries.
Tech Week's NYC calendar lists hackathons across Manhattan and Brooklyn each June, alongside university-hosted events at NYU and Columbia.
The ARRL club directory lists Queens clubs offering entry-level licence classes and test sessions, including Hall of Science Amateur Radio Club and ARC Emergency Communications Service.
venue: Hall of Science Amateur Radio Club

how: Anarcho-Tech NYC runs a beginner-friendly CTF team and NYU's Cybersecurity Club holds weekly HackNights and CTF101 sessions.
OWASP New York City holds open application-security meetups, and many developer meetups and NYU/Columbia tech clubs run regular events.
HB Studio in Greenwich Village teaches acting classes, one of many conservatories and studios offering adult courses.
NYC Parks Urban Park Rangers and partner groups lead free guided hikes and nature walks through the city's parks.
The Escape Game NYC in Midtown and many other operators run one-hour themed escape rooms.
